summary: Back-link from an entity created by a visual effect (e.g. the light of an effect's Light component) to the effect entity that owns it; seen on equipment, spells, potions, dialogues.

fields.name: Effect
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3F4ED10 (the only user of the string "Appearance.Light UUID" - an effect light component setting up its light entity) adds the component with AllocRaw(8), initialises it to the null handle 0xFFC0000000000000 and then stores *(this + 0x48) - the owning effect's entity handle - into it; bg3.exe+0x3D00DE0 reads it by entity. Live: entity handles (high dword 0x01400001.. type bits).

open_questions: Whether +0x48 of the effect-side object is the effect entity itself or its parent effect - assumed the effect.
raw_check: 48 instances, se-fork/coverage/check.py raw stage, game v4.76.31.656
